summary: NPN low side at 3.30 V drive: base 2.53 mA net, forced beta 5.1; saturates by the hFE_min/2 rule of thumb (hFE_min 100, 2N2222A datasheet).

hfe.conditions: T_A = 25 °C; ON characteristics measured as pulse test (Note 1)

result.formula: I_RB = (V_drive − V_BE) / R_B; I_PD = V_BE / R_PD; I_B = I_RB − I_PD; β_forced = I_load / I_B; P_RB = I_RB² · R_B; saturated if β_forced ≤ hFE_min / 2 (rule of thumb)

checks.detail: β_forced 5.1 x ≤ hFE_min/2 = 50 x (hFE_min 100 from 2N2222A datasheet; rule of thumb)
I_load 13.0 mA ≤ I_C continuous 800 mA (2N2222A datasheet, maximum ratings)

warnings.message: The driving pin sources 2.60 mA. GPIO current limits are not checked here (unverified); see the chip datasheet.
Laser modules can damage eyes. Never look into the beam; keep the output off during boot (pull-down).

assumptions.reason: typical small-signal silicon BJT; check the datasheet
while the transistor is on, R_PD sees V_BE
the datasheet lists I_C 10.0 mA (min 100) and 150 mA (min 100); the smaller minimum is used for I_load 13.0 mA

assumptions.value: V_CE 10.0 V, T_A = 25 °C; ON characteristics measured as pulse test (Note 1)
assumptions.reason: datasheet hFE of 2N2222A (onsemi-2n2222a); other makers and packages differ, and the gain in saturation is lower
